code_paths.purpose: Initial stateless validation of the NFTokenCancelOffer transaction. Checks for malformed input, such as empty or oversized offer lists and duplicate offer IDs.
validation_points: Check if sfNFTokenOffers is empty or exceeds maxTokenOfferCancelCount
Check for duplicate IDs in sfNFTokenOffers using std::sort + std::adjacent_find

code_paths.purpose: Stateful validation: checks ledger state to ensure the account has permission to cancel each offer.
validation_points: For each id in sfNFTokenOffers: check if offer exists in ledger
Check if offer is of type ltNFTOKEN_OFFER
Check if account is owner or destination

code_paths.purpose: Applies the transaction: attempts to delete each offer from the ledger.
validation_points: No new validation; assumes preflight and preclaim have passed

flow: Read in preflight for size and duplicate checks
Read in preclaim for per-offer permission checks
Used in doApply to delete offers
transformations: In preflight: copied to STVector256, sorted, checked for duplicates
In preclaim: iterated, each id used to lookup ledger entry
In doApply: iterated, each id used to delete offer

flow: Read in preclaim for permission checks
Looked up in preclaim for each id
Checked for type, expiration, owner, destination

description: Implements the logic for the NFTokenCancelOffer transaction, including preflight, preclaim, and apply steps for cancelling NFT offers on the XRPL ledger.

validation_architecture.framework: Custom validation in transaction preflight/preclaim/apply pattern (Rippled transaction engine)

validates: Ensures the sfNFTokenOffers field is not empty
Ensures the sfNFTokenOffers field does not exceed maxTokenOfferCancelCount
Ensures there are no duplicate offer IDs in sfNFTokenOffers
Checks if the offer exists in the ledger (if not, it's assumed consumed and skipped)
Checks if the offer is of type ltNFTOKEN_OFFER (if not, permission denied)
Allows anyone to cancel if the offer is expired
Allows the owner of the offer to cancel
Allows the destination (recipient) of the offer to cancel
Checks that the offer can be deleted from the ledger
